models.name: placeholder_sys_config
models.description: Placeholder system configuration table for future extensibility within the Systematic domain. Maintains architectural clarity and readiness for system-wide settings without current business logic dependencies.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the record was soft deleted.

models.name: discussion_board_members
models.description: Members who are authenticated users authorized to create and manage articles and comments within the discussion board system. Members have personal credentials and are subject to soft deletion. This table stores member identity, authentication credentials, and metadata.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address of the member used for authentication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Password hash for secure authentication of member accounts.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when the member account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when the member account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Optional deletion timestamp for soft delete.

models.name: discussion_board_member_sessions
models.description: Active sessions for members representing authenticated login instances. Each session records connection details, access timestamps, and expiration, supporting secure session management and auditing.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced member id owning this session. {@link discussion_board_members.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client initiating this session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: The connection URL when the session was started.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: The referrer URL for this session connection.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Optional expiration timestamp of the session.

models.name: discussion_board_admins
models.description: Administrators with elevated privileges managing all content and user accounts on the discussion board system. Admin accounts are authenticated with password hashes and support soft deletion.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address of the administrator for authentication purposes.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for administrator account authentication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Optional timestamp marking soft deletion of the admin account.

models.name: discussion_board_admin_sessions
models.description: Active session records for administrators managing the discussion board system. Sessions track connection metadata and support secure authentication and auditing.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced administrator id owning this session. {@link discussion_board_admins.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the connection client for this session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: The URL used to initiate this session connection.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL leading to this session start.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this admin session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Optional expiration timestamp of this session.

models.name: discussion_board_articles
models.description: Articles posted by members on the discussion board, containing a title and markdown content. Includes timestamps for creation, updating, and optional soft deletion. Serves as the main content entity users interact with.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the article, up to 200 characters.

plainFields.name: content_markdown
plainFields.description: Markdown formatted body content of the article.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the article was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the article was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp, null if the article is active.

models.name: discussion_board_attachments
models.description: Attachments associated with discussion board articles. Supports images and files linked securely to their parent article. Includes filename, file type, URL/path, and timestamps. Serves as a subsidiary supporting entity for richer article content.

plainFields.name: filename
plainFields.description: Original filename of the attachment.

plainFields.name: file_type
plainFields.description: MIME type or file type such as image, pdf, etc.

plainFields.name: file_url
plainFields.description: URL or storage path of the attachment file.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the attachment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the attachment was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp, null if active.
